description.value: Pizza24 is a Fraser Valley pizza chain operating since 2010, and this Abbotsford location sits inside a Co-op Gas Station on Blueridge Drive. The menu spans dozens of specialty and vegetarian pizzas, pasta, wings, and salads available for delivery or pick-up. A drive-through window is available for late-night orders, making it a practical stop for cyclists on an evening route.
